purpose: Candidate-only supplement for experiments whose original-publication cell is blank in the frozen Zenodo references workbook. This file does not modify the source workbook or authorize ranking.
source_reference_policy: A candidate is usable only after an exact experiment/site/year/design match and independent review are both recorded. Related, aggregate, partial, or year-mismatched publications remain unusable.

candidates.candidate_source: Producing organic wheat with high grain protein content: the significance of intercropping and the need for diagnostic tools
candidates.evidence_locator: Abstract: experiments reported for 2007 and 2009 in western France
candidates.evidence_summary: The source year does not cover the 2005-2006 Thorigne trial.

candidates.candidate_source: Cultivar Grain Yield in Durum Wheat-Grain Legume Intercrops Could Be Estimated From Sole Crop Yields and Interspecific Interaction Index

candidates.evidence_summary: The candidate starts one season after the dataset trial, which was sown 2010-12-03 and harvested 2011-06-30.

candidates.candidate_source: Ecological principles underlying the increase of productivity achieved by cereal-grain legume intercrops in organic farming: a review
candidates.evidence_locator: Table 1: 2010 South of France (Toulouse area), durum wheat-faba bean, L1823/Castel among listed cultivar combinations
candidates.evidence_summary: The table matches year, region, and one cultivar pair, but does not bind the named experiment or its chickpea packages and is a secondary synthesis.

candidates.candidate_source: A global dataset gathering 37 field experiments involving cereal-legume intercrops and their corresponding sole crops
candidates.evidence_locator: references.xlsx: blank original-reference cell for Auzeville_marinette_1_2015
candidates.evidence_summary: The dataset record proves provenance of the data deposit but is not an independently reported original experimental publication.

candidates.candidate_source: Nitrogen nutrition of winter pea-wheat intercrops: analysis, modelling, and propositions for N-management strategies
candidates.evidence_locator: Experiment table: Grignon 2007, wheat Trocadero and pea Cartouche
candidates.evidence_summary: The thesis matches a subset of the site-year and cultivars, but the dataset experiment contains additional cultivar packages and an authoritative repository copy is still required.

candidates.candidate_source: The effect of various dynamics of N availability on winter pea-wheat intercrops
candidates.evidence_locator: Methods/general design: 2007-2008 experiment at Thiverval-Grignon; wheat Trocadero and pea Cartouche
candidates.evidence_summary: The article exactly matches a Grignon 2008 subset, but the dataset record combines additional cultivar packages not established by this source.

candidates.candidate_source: Crop Management Affects the Performance of a Winter Pea-Wheat Intercrop
candidates.evidence_locator: Methods: two-year Grignon experiment; 2008-2009 season; wheat Cezanne and pea Isard; sowing-proportion and N-fertilization treatments
candidates.evidence_summary: Site, season, cultivars, and the management factors match the dataset trial; the same DOI is already linked by the frozen workbook to Grignon_inrae_2010, the second study year.

candidates.candidate_source: Interspecific interactions regulate plant reproductive allometry in cereal-legume intercropping systems
candidates.evidence_locator: Methods/data statement: aggregate analysis of 28 cereal-legume field trials
candidates.evidence_summary: The publication reuses an aggregate trial collection but does not expose an exact Grignon 2017 design binding in the article.
